name: Candied Oblivion 2: Caramelization
source:
A grounded sequel to Candied Oblivion. The life-changing events of the first game are played out according to the player. 

[From [url=https://thesugarray.itch.io/thesugarrays-demo-disk]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
回归现实基调的《蜜饯遗忘》（Candied Oblivion）续作。初代作品中那些改变人生的重大事件，将完全依据玩家此前的抉择在后续日常中逐一展开。

[摘自[url=https://thesugarray.itch.io/thesugarrays-demo-disk]itch.io[/url]]
